headline: Amazon Web Services Commits $4 Billion Tech Hub Investment in Chile
summary: AWS Vice President Paula Bellizia confirmed plans for a $4 billion, 15-year investment commitment in Chile, citing the country's potential as a South American technology hub.
why: Amazon Web Services is a dominant global cloud provider, expanding infrastructure across emerging Latin American enterprise markets.

impacts.name: Amazon.com
impacts.why: Long-term capital expenditure builds cloud infrastructure and enterprise market presence in South America.
